gemini.title: Statutory Main Rivers
gemini.abstract: Line network of watercourses legally designated as Main River in England, where the Environment Agency has permissive powers for flood-risk management.
gemini.lineage: Published by Environment Agency as open environmental data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: fid

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Legal or operational classification of the watercourse, such as Main River.
